A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SV40 transformants show a much more rapid and extensive loss of cell surface processes than do the nonmalignant cells.
the SV40-transformants show more cell-cell contacts, more cell-substrate contacts, more cell spreading, and a higher rate of growth than 3T3.
cell surface topography is a dynamic process which is altered in malignant transformation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cell surface topography is an important parameter in cell adhesion.
the surfaces of interior and peripheral 3T3 cell layers differ in morphology.
the surface topography of the outer layer of an aggregate is different from the surface topography in the interior of the aggregate, regardless of the cell type.
